query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT p.ref_id FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.ref_id = r.ref_id AND p.category = 'office products' AND p.status = 'active' WHERE r.verified = 1 AND p.status = 'active' AND r.rating IS NOT NULL AND r.year IS NOT NULL AND r.month IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.ref_id HAVING AVG(r.rating) = 5.0 AND COUNT(r.rating) >= 5)
